title: Articular Cartilage Defects
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Assess the painful arc, since a defect is loaded at a particular flexion angle and the arc should match its position.
Assess the effusion, since a recurrent activity related effusion is the most useful sign that a defect is symptomatic.
Ask about mechanical symptoms, since a delaminated flap catches and that changes the decision.
Assess the alignment, since it determines whether the compartment carrying the defect is being loaded.
Assess the meniscal status in that compartment, since a deficient meniscus concentrates the load on the surface.
